shots.narrativePurpose: Make the difference between a decorative still and a directable scene emotionally obvious before explaining any capability.
shots.dominantSubject: one unfinished boat scene made from loose paper cutouts
shots.startState: The boat, water, character, and timing strip exist as disconnected paper pieces.
shots.mainAction: The pieces gather toward one off-center boat silhouette while the camera makes a restrained side push.
shots.endState: The unfinished scene becomes a clear hero object with one visible horizon seam.
shots.cameraPlan: Begin in an intimate three-quarter tabletop view, then push 12% toward the boat; do not orbit or drift.
shots.materialRule: Loose pieces have long soft shadows; aligned pieces lose height and their shadows tighten.
shots.transitionOut: The saffron timing strip lengthens into shot 02's shared construction hinge.
audioCues: paper draw at the last gathering piece
soft low hit when the horizon aligns
shots.antiPattern: Do not introduce four fragments with the same bounce or make the opening a title slate.

shots.narrativePurpose: Show that story, material, and composition become a working world rather than a set of feature cards.
shots.dominantSubject: the paper world lifting from one shared fold
shots.startState: All scene pieces are flat on the paper desk and share one saffron construction seam.
shots.mainAction: The mountain, water plane, and boat scene stand up in depth order from the seam, with the camera correcting from overhead to a readable side view.
shots.endState: The paper world has height, shadow, and a single playable stage.
shots.cameraPlan: One continuous tilt from top-down construction to a 35-degree side reading angle; camera stops before the information is read.
shots.materialRule: Every piece rotates from its own fold line and keeps a ground shadow that narrows as it rises.
shots.transitionOut: The construction seam becomes a vermilion thread that leads to the press point in shot 03.
audioCues: three quiet paper creases in depth order
short room tone drop at the settled stage
shots.antiPattern: Do not swap in a static card grid or make the rising pieces unreadable at their hero angle.

shots.narrativePurpose: Give human direction a physical, consequential action instead of presenting it as optional configuration.
shots.startState: Three production choices hover as unfinished paper slips around an open decision ring.
shots.mainAction: The single director stamp presses the center; the slips snap into a fixed production order and their shadows compress at the same frame.
shots.endState: The red mark owns the frame while the three choices become supporting evidence around it.
shots.cameraPlan: Locked, low side view for weight and legibility; no camera shake.
shots.materialRule: Press impact simultaneously flattens the stamp, tightens all shadows, and stops every residual paper wobble.
shots.transitionOut: The stamp ring enlarges into the circular proof window of shot 04.
shots.antiPattern: Do not make three equal cards pop in or reduce the decision to a checkbox.

shots.narrativePurpose: Turn the project’s layer correctness claim into a single visible proof rather than explanatory copy.
shots.dominantSubject: the exact relationship between the character and boat
shots.startState: A narrow proof window shows a layered scene with the relation not yet exposed.
shots.mainAction: The scene rotates just enough to show water behind boat and character on boat; one vermilion thread draws from the character tag to the boat tag.
shots.endState: Both endpoints and their depth order remain readable inside one stable proof frame.
shots.cameraPlan: Slow 16-degree orbital reveal, then a locked frontal reading view for the final second.
shots.materialRule: The proof line follows real page-space endpoints and never floats above unrelated layers.
shots.transitionOut: The proof window opens like a physical folio cover for shot 05.
audioCues: small paper stop at the reading hold
shots.antiPattern: Do not draw dangling connector lines or let the technical labels cover the boat or character.

shots.narrativePurpose: End on an authentic, inspectable project artifact that feels like the beginning of further work rather than a CTA slate.
shots.dominantSubject: the opened paper folio containing the real project page
shots.startState: The proof window is closed into a dark blue paper cover with one red binding thread.
shots.mainAction: The cover opens toward camera to reveal a readable captured project page, then settles into a printed spine carrying the project address.
shots.endState: The public artifact, project name, and address form one calm final object.
shots.cameraPlan: A controlled pullback from the opening folio; final framing locks for 1.2 seconds.
shots.materialRule: The README remains an authentic captured image; its paper frame and spine are original graphics, not a fake GitHub UI.
shots.antiPattern: Do not shrink the real artifact into a decorative tile or end with a separate URL card.
